assessments.reasoning: Section 3.1 first presents a didactic separate Proof p encoding, then gives Lean's actual identification of a proof of p with a term of type p.

challenge.method: Compared the initial hypothetical constants with the later built-in Prop treatment and the explicit relation between a proposition and a type-checking proof term.
challenge.results: The separate Proof constructor belongs to the example encoding. Lean uses p itself as the type of proofs after the identification.

limitations: The finding concerns the described Lean 3 propositions-as-types model. It does not identify the tutorial encoding as built-in syntax.
